goals.origin: The earlier five-file host stage did not implement delivery serialization. During development of the pure-memory codec, transient tool outputs reported acceptance of extra session data, mutable/empty content and bad candidate identities, with a missing member raising KeyError rather than controlled ValueError; 18 damaged-header/checksum/padding cases accepted; 7 jointly forged expected-manifest/archive cases accepted; and 5 resource-limit or mutable-archive contract failures. There is no saved RED XML for these original codec observations; their counts and provenance come from the implementing agent's retained report, not a reconstructed failure artifact. Implementation also exposed an incorrect magic/version octal escape, noncanonical ASCII-zero devmajor/devminor fields versus the independent standard-library writer's all-NUL fields, and a checksum helper that accidentally recalculated away its intended corruption. build/delivery-content-20261004-green-final.xml retains 125 later local synthetic cases. These are development and test-oracle findings, not a publisher bypass, camera failure or qualified release result.
goals.required_behavior: Use exactly 8+1 ordered regular members in deterministic uncompressed USTAR: libx2dii_menu.so, X2d2MenuBootstrap.qml, X2d2MenuModel.qml, X2d2MenuPage.qml, camera-gui.rc.proposed, install-files.sh, activate-boot.sh, restore-boot.sh, then generated members.json. The manifest describes only the eight inputs, binds their exact immutable nonempty bytes, lowercase SHA256, fixed names/order and archive modes, and identifies the candidate and format. Keep archive and member-manifest hashes detached rather than creating a self-hash cycle. Session, live observation, qualification and approval are outside this stable content format. Verify fields and content with an independent reader that does not regenerate an archive through the encoder; use separate standard-library reader/writer oracles for the contract. Reject malformed, duplicate, missing, extra, reordered, absolute or traversal names, links and nonregular entries, noncanonical metadata or numbers, checksum/content changes, padding changes, truncation, concatenated archives and any trailing bytes beyond exactly two zero blocks. Canonical archive modes, zero uid/gid/mtime and empty owner/group/link/prefix fields describe the format, not target ownership, xattrs or SELinux proof. Bound each input to 64 MiB, the whole archive to 128 MiB and members.json to 8192 bytes before oversized serialization or reading. Pure-memory synthetic round trips supply byte identity only; genuine candidate publication, current provenance, package integration, target behavior and all remaining release gates stay NOT_RUN or PENDING until separately evidenced.

goals.required_behavior: Use a shared publish_output_set persistence boundary for the complete declared install or recovery output set, not independent writes that can expose a success marker too early. This core grants no qualification or device authority; each production caller supplies its final precommit current-qualification check as before_commit. Freeze and validate the exact output names/bytes and commit member, reject redirection and unknown collisions, and keep a new incomplete set visibly uncommitted. Write the prospective commit under a distinct exclusively created .pending name, verify the full write count, flush/fsync/close and exact readback; parseable JSON or absence of an exception is not full-byte publication proof. Complete all-member byte readback and identity/membership checks before the final callback. After that callback returns, recheck every previously verified member's inode, size, mtime, ctime and the entire member set before making the final marker visible, so a late callback mutation cannot be briefly published and then excused by later cleanup. Avoid a new unbounded full-byte read after current-qualification admission that silently consumes the short lease; retain final qualified-caller freshness and the explicit limits of metadata revalidation. Promote the fully checked pending marker using proven Windows non-overwriting rename semantics; reject non-Windows execution explicitly unless an independently reviewed equivalent exists, and never substitute an overwriting POSIX rename. A last-moment destination race must preserve the competing file. An existing directory is acceptable only as a complete exact read-only idempotent set, with no mkdir, repair, rewrite or deletion; missing, partial, extra, modified, linked or nonregular members fail closed. On caught failure, retract only this attempt's known inode containing its exact complete formal marker bytes; never delete an unknown replacement, a same-byte different inode, an altered original inode or a valid pre-existing commit. If safe retraction cannot be verified because I/O persistently fails, report that failure and residual uncertainty explicitly and do not claim success or recoverability. Preserve partial/pending diagnostic material rather than inventing a valid committed set. This is not group-atomic storage, proof against concurrent parent replacement, or hard power loss recovery; those limitations, whole-release qualification and real target evidence remain NOT_RUN or PENDING.

goals.required_behavior: Bind failed-attempt withdrawal to the original file object, not a pathname stat followed by unlink. Obtain a metadata-only ReOpenFile lifetime pin from the original creating writer while that writer is still alive; verify its volume identity and 128-bit file ID match, and retain the pin through promotion, failure handling and withdrawal so the original ID cannot be recycled for a rival. The pin is not an exclusive-writer lock and does not replace the documented no other writer precondition for the entire call. Open the prospective formal marker with read/delete access, share mode zero, OPEN_EXISTING and OPEN_REPARSE_POINT; reject an incompatible existing reader or failed open instead of weakening sharing. Through the same handle, compare the opened object's identity to the live original pin, reject reparse/nonregular/multilink or length mismatch, verify exact expected bytes and unchanged before/after metadata, then request deletion with SetFileInformationByHandle on that same handle. Perform no pathname unlink fallback and no later name resolution as deletion authority. Preserve same-byte and different-byte replacements appearing before open, and ensure an attempted final-boundary rename/write either is denied by the held handle or cannot redirect deletion to the rival. Native handle/descriptor ownership must transfer exactly once; failures opening, pinning, validating, reading, setting disposition or closing must remain observable, with nested close diagnostics carried onto the original publication exception. Track this call's publication_error explicitly rather than consulting sys.exception, which can describe a caller's unrelated except block. A final pin close failure after otherwise successful publication must raise, report that the formal marker may remain, state withdrawal unverified and do not reuse the failed output set; never blindly retry an uncertain close or invent successful retraction. An unverified failure can intentionally preserve the formal marker, so do not claim every failure retracts it. This is a narrowly verified Windows leaf-withdrawal protection, not group-atomic output publication, protection for all parent replacement checks, hard power loss recovery, completion of all RG408 obligations or camera/package qualification. Keep the original goals and demonstration evidence intact and every new registry result NOT_RUN.

The retained baseline has zero real os.symlink calls and one setup skip; it is missing execution evidence, not a pytest RED or proof of link rejection. Removing only that decorator and handling Windows WinError 1314 after the real symlink attempt changes the test snapshot: one actual creation call now raises 1314 and skips during call, so native link rejection remains unverified. When creation succeeds, execute the existing public delivery assembler and require rejection of the real symlink. Only an actual Windows OSError carrying winerror 1314 may justify the capability skip; propagate every other creation exception instead of silently skipping. Keep no permission escalation, no machine-setting change and no simulated native-success substitution. Preserve exact source hashes, pytest phase/outcome and observed call/error provenance, distinguishing an unconditional setup skip, actual permission denial, modeled reparse checks and a real link-rejection pass. A modeled or synthetic check does not close the missing native-link evidence. Preserve the RG418 reports and all previous requirements, applicability seeds, statuses and evidence unchanged; the modified test and RG419 inventory form a new source snapshot and cannot inherit the RG418 full audit conclusion. Keep RG419 APPLICABLE with NOT_RUN, counts_as_pass false and empty evidence_refs. Local registry or focused test results grant no packaging, camera, release, approval or installation authority; a future candidate requires fresh complete applicable verification bound to its own current source and package hashes.

The old host checker rejected field 1 with ADB_IDENTITY_MISMATCH despite receiving the expected identity. build/domain-terminator-red.xml reproduces that exact local parser defect without camera access. The temporary window ended and the original connection was restored; neither offline replay nor the historical identity query proves current ADB availability or system write permission.
goals.required_behavior: Preserve RG381's exact six identity values and original failure diagnostics while accepting the domain value's legal optional single terminal NUL representation. Do not globally strip NULs or accept embedded, repeated, leading or wrong-field NULs; a different domain with a terminal NUL remains a mismatch. Preserve the fixed query, AUTH refusal, packet validation and one-attempt transport behavior. Replay saved data offline, keep historical failed reports unchanged, and do not request another camera connection to diagnose this parser issue. Bind the generated checker and observer pin to the reviewed source. Local parser acceptance is not live loading, installation, complete permissions or release qualification.
required_evidence: Replay the exact retained 147-byte decoded identity through public ValidateIdentity; preserve failing and passing local results separately from the original live run.

Accept the recorded LF form, CRLF transport form and domain without a NUL; reject embedded, repeated and leading NULs, wrong domains, NULs in other fields, wrong UID, USB state, adbd state and completion marker, while preserving exact bounded diagnostic input.
Independently review the parser and regenerated observer hash; rerun related offline USB tests without opening, enumerating or switching a camera.

Preserve all first 419 goals and applicability rows unchanged. Keep this requirement APPLICABLE/NOT_RUN in the requirements inventory, with no invented PASS or evidence promotion; final candidate qualification requires fresh applicable verification.

goals.origin: Route review against pinned reference 9f6c9baffeaf30ac805905f8052973f60b11acf6 found that the local installer expects /blackbox/x2dii-menu-stage/<candidate prefix> without a connected payload sender, and install/activate/restore leave camera-gui stopped. Changing camera-gui.rc on disk does not prove init has reparsed the service. The reference temporary-stock-test.sh also exits its stop-file loop without terminating its manually started GUI; init stop alone cannot establish that this direct child exited. These are deployment/lifecycle gaps, not evidence that historical candidate installation and official rollback never happened.
goals.required_behavior: Complete fixed-candidate staging and an explicitly scoped temporary menu lifecycle using the existing original-GUI independent-extension route. Do not add AF, burst, sensor or photo-save changes. Keep the final eight-member delivery contract and final qualification/approval gates intact. A temporary validation action must have its own purpose/action binding and cannot inherit the consumed identity-only ADB permission or be accepted by activate/restore as a final install session. Compilation and local rendering must not connect or write a camera. Staging must reject existing targets, preserve ordered exact readback, stop on uncertainty and never trigger installation. A direct GUI child requires recorded PID/start_ticks/executable/hash/domain/namespace, bounded supervision and identity-safe exit; do not assume su gives the original GUI domain. Confirm child exit and no extension mappings before removing only owned files, then verify original-GUI recovery rather than reporting success on start alone. Preserve the per-boot attempt marker, original rc, photos, calibration and independent official recovery. Full menu entry/page/return, original shooting and saving, reboot loading and removal require fresh actual target results; offline evidence, installation and hashes are not substitutes.
required_evidence: Execute fixed-byte staging and negative ordering/partial/error/existing-directory cases in the existing local shell boundary; verify the dedicated host source remains fixed-operation, deadline-bounded and qualification-gated, without an arbitrary public shell API or automatic installation.

Run temporary lifecycle tests for exact-purpose admission, original default behavior, normal exit, startup failure, timeout/signals, changed PID/boot/domain and recovery failure. Preserve known limitations instead of weakening guards or labeling unexecuted target behavior PASS.

Independently review the deployment-to-loader and loader-to-recovery connections. Separate nonpublishing local source, specifically approved temporary validation and final approved installation; do not resolve first-load qualification dependence by inventing final PASS evidence.

Retain the lifecycle regressions found during implementation: reject existing attempt/disable markers before stopping the GUI; freeze the direct child's first observed birth and parent instead of adopting a reused PID; handle verified disappearance during TERM wait or a failed TERM/KILL without adopting a live reused PID; propagate a failed remount command even when a subsequent mount-state read reports read-only; retain an unknown partial stage and failure status while independently attempting only a proven stock-GUI recovery; reject backend drift after temporary loading rather than reporting restored success.

Retain the staging review regressions: matching stdout must not hide a failed metadata or hash command; preserve received bounded bytes and original transport failure; recompute the exact eight-member delivery_identity before qualified source generation. Execute long-path Windows shell fixtures through stdin so command-line truncation cannot masquerade as a device or payload fault. Check the real candidate's complete rendered commands against the negotiated packet limit and fixed window budget; an unmeasured transfer duration remains unknown, not a claimed deployment success.

Close the execution-data gap separately from fixed content: derive session-context.data from the original renderer and the same qualified current context, stage and read back its exact bytes, then expose its verified path/hash for the three scripts' required arguments. Bind the distinct window to this data hash while preserving the eight-member plan, original boot/namespace/nonce and unrenewed expiry. Do not relabel temporary v3 or recovery v1 data as formal install v2, overwrite an existing data file, or treat transferred files as an executed installation.

Preserve all first 420 goals and applicability rows. Keep this goal APPLICABLE/NOT_RUN in the requirements inventory until separately bound execution evidence exists; complete final applicable checks on the frozen candidate rather than reusing previous audits.
goals.title: Connect fixed deployment, explicit menu loading and owned-process recovery without substituting file success for operation

goals.origin: Reference 9f6c9baffeaf30ac805905f8052973f60b11acf6 separates ADB file installation from Read-ReviewedUsb temporary GUI startup; build_native_install.py explicitly notes that su cannot read the original labeled executables or maintenance private state. Usb.ps1 and ShellTransport.inc.cs are absent only from the sparse working-tree paths, not from that fixed Git commit. Direct git show inspection confirms Read-ReviewedUsb calls RunReviewedBatch and its fixed HblShell operation; this source fact and the historical device-domain statement are not current X2D II execution evidence. Do not infer missing reference code from a sparse-filesystem search alone. Local prepare_peer_install.py instead combined original core/proc verification, /tmp locks, /system mkdir/chcon and direct GUI launch under u:r:su:s0. Desktop fixtures supplied those permissions and a maintenance-domain child, masking the incompatibility. Review of the four official platform, mapping, vendor and public-versioned CIL inputs found no su-to-original-GUI transition, no su creation of system_file directories, no system_file relabel grant, and no su read of init/adbd proc links. Maintenance file-read grants also do not establish search permission for every process directory. The RG421 full audit was explicitly interrupted with exit 1; build/peer-route-review-20261004-rg421/AUDIT.json is not a completed full-suite result.
goals.required_behavior: Use u:r:su:s0 for demonstrated fixed extension-file operations and u:r:hbl_camera_service:s0 for original-component observation, /tmp lifecycle state, original GUI control and explicit loading. Do not infer permissions from UID 0, a file-read allow without directory search, a static policy or a previous identity-only USB window. Bind both real roles to one candidate, boot, namespace, nonce, ordered action and original 600-second lease without renewal or stale checkpoint replay. Keep the maintenance observer and file worker identities distinct; no su reads of inaccessible original ELF, init/adbd proc links or maintenance private files. No unsupported /system directory creation or unconditional chcon. No weakening guards, domain substitutions, permissive mode, automatic policy changes or speculative runcon. All-process maps coverage must be demonstrated; EACCES cannot mean ENOENT or absence, and GUI-only observation cannot silently replace full unmapping before file removal. Maintenance-only GUI recovery is not file removal or complete rollback. A partial role adaptation remains local-only; formal publication, qualification and final user approval requirements remain unchanged.
required_evidence: Execute role-constrained positive and negative fixtures at the existing rendered-script boundary: su cannot inspect maintenance ELF/private /tmp or manufacture a maintenance child; the maintenance lifecycle cannot write, remove, relabel or remount /system. A pre-staging error must leave the original GUI running. Preserve existing birth/PPID/PID reuse, deadline, attempt/disable marker, backend drift, command-status and recovery regressions.

Exercise same-candidate/current-boot/nonce/namespace/role and ordered handoff checks, failed or missing worker/observer, expired or reused observations, partial copies and uncertain transport. Fail without new writes on an unverified handoff; independently report original GUI recovery and pending exact-owned file withdrawal rather than emitting complete rollback success.

Preserve the late-launch deadline regression in test_original_session_deadline_is_not_extended_by_a_late_child_launch: starting the 120-second child window near original second 599 cannot extend the original 600-second lease. Check the original deadline before reporting a loaded child and throughout supervision; expiration must still attempt identity-bound original-GUI recovery without authorizing new forward operations.

Preserve the su preplacement regressions: the existing strict less-than-8-MiB payload bound must not be widened to the archive format's larger member bound; a successful label reply for another path is not this file's metadata; initial empty-file diagnostics are not a committed final-identity receipt; recheck exact owned identity after a final hash query so a same-content replacement inode is not adopted. Retain partial or replaced files, never claim removal, and distinguish a valid local single-file receipt from the still-unconnected maintenance write-boundary supervision.

Independently review the platform CIL, mapping/28.0.cil, vendor CIL and vendor plat_pub_versioned.cil with attribute expansion. Retain their exact input identities, historical labels and reference source lines; static results are not the current loaded policy, current enforcing state, live directory labels or proof the two USB paths can coexist.

Add inaccessible-process-directory and maps-query error cases; neither a glob that omits inaccessible paths nor a false -e result may count as proof that no extension mapping exists. If full coverage cannot be established, retain files and an unresolved removal gate rather than making the target less restrictive.

Keep the existing read-only collector read-only and fixed staging transport staging-only. Do not create an arbitrary command executor or silently extend a consumed identity-only approval. Complete the fixed-role deployment, launch, reboot and removal connections before claiming installation readiness, with new candidate-specific offline and actual target evidence.

Exercise the four actual locally preplaced payloads as maintenance input without re-creating them in a helper; an incomplete fourth copy must prevent GUI stop and leave the first three and partial file intact. Freeze the first three files' inode/size/mtime/hash and official rc BEFORE the failing fourth operation, compare them after the failure, fixture handoff and maintenance rejection, and bind their initial hashes to the candidate. Sampling only bytes after the failure cannot prove that the failed worker preserved the earlier files; the earlier green integration result did not cover that missing pre-failure baseline. This filesystem handoff test is not the missing dual-transport coordinator. Preserve build/temporary-domain-integration-20261004-first.xml's two setup-keyword TypeErrors as a test-helper interface failure before either renderer ran, not a camera or permission failure. The legacy formal install/recovery renderers and fixed staging namespace checks must also receive the domain split; fixing only temporary GUI supervision cannot close those paths.

Preserve the first 421 goals and applicability rows unchanged. This new requirement remains APPLICABLE/NOT_RUN with no inferred device result. Preserve the interrupted RG421 audit, require a new coherent snapshot for the next full run, and never attribute earlier component or suite passes to changed role-aware sources.

Missing, stale, replayed, out-of-order or timed-out acknowledgements cannot release a write. On refusal retain uncertain objects and restore only the owned mount to its original read-only state.

Run the actual worker, actual read-only maintenance observer and production reply coordinator on one unchanged local tree. Explicitly distinguish OS fixtures and physical ADB/SELinux behavior; do not infer removal or installation qualification from a receipt.

Run the actual generated C# receiver and coordinator boundaries, not only helper regex tests; retain unmodified output and explicit native completion status. A modelled completed stream is not live installation evidence.

goals.origin: Independent review found RunFixedWorker accepted nonempty OKAY and CLSE payloads despite legal framing/checksums. The generated receiver was exercised at the native I/O boundary: build/menu-transport-native-boundary-control-red.xml showed all three malformed controls incorrectly completing four files.

required_evidence: Keep Send, ReceiveExact, Receive, RunFixedWorker and RunFourFiles real in offline tests, substituting only native I/O/open/time boundaries. Cover split USB reads and split WRTE lines, wrong IDs, truncation, acknowledgement timing, output retention and incomplete closure.

The ordinary generated source must still refuse before native device access until the complete sender is qualified. Any counterfactual admission in a native-free test assembly is explicitly test-only, never a production permission switch or live result.
goals.title: Validate control-frame payloads in the real ADB receiver loop

goals.origin: Static staging feasibility exposed at least 198 ADB commands for the five real payload/rc files plus four approximately 48KB preplacement programs, excluding boot programs. At the current maintenance transport's one-second inter-command delay, per-chunk observation alone exceeds the original 90-second USB window. Separately, FixedStagingExchange accepted a su completion nine seconds after its release despite an eight-second fresh maintenance check.
goals.required_behavior: Do not confuse the 600-second original session lease with the 90-second USB window. Use bounded fixed-content transfer with exact complete readback and maintain checks at actual transaction boundaries; eliminate redundant per-chunk round trips rather than simply extending the window or deleting guards. Recheck freshness immediately before native send, reject stale completions and ensure device-side actions cannot use a queued stale release. A next_step property check alone is not a send-time guarantee.
required_evidence: Bind transfer-size and command-count analysis to actual candidate/program bytes; exercise retained fixed data and partial transfer failures with no installer launch on incomplete content. Use measured target duration before claiming the transfer fits; synthetic clock tests cannot prove throughput.

Preserve delayed-release and delayed-completion tests. Confirm short maintenance launch envelopes remain below 232 bytes, ADB requests below negotiated limits, and source/data/command-index/nonce hashes agree. Keep the reference 90-second worker and original USB restoration semantics.
goals.title: Fit staged transfer into the real USB window and preserve freshness at send

goals.origin: The first dual-role test stopped before a boundary because a Windows-path nested shell converted a POSIX session path to F:/ syntax (exit 32); using the same MSYS shell fixed the launch. The next real receipt was correctly rejected because the fixture model reported root ownership in one stat shape but native Windows UID/GID 197609 in another. goals.required_behavior: Diagnose tool/fixture output before attributing failure to camera permission. Model OS ownership consistently while retaining native inode/link/length observations. Pass actual written files, original session bytes and observer state between roles without recreating payloads or resetting observations. Keep failure artifacts distinct from subsequent successes.
required_evidence: Execute worker pipe to observer shell to coordinator ACK to final receipt for all four files, then hand those same files into maintenance lifecycle. Compare prior payload inode/size/mtime/hash and original session before and after each subsequent operation and GUI restoration.

A changed backend before rename prevents commit and leaves the original GUI running/read-only mount restored. Assert the injected change actually occurred. Retaining files after GUI restoration is not complete removal or rollback.
goals.title: Do not conceal local fixture failures or reset real handoff state

goals.origin: The first role-split rc renderer embedded the current session hash, and restoration embedded the saved backup identity, into program bytes. That makes a supposedly stable release depend on a transient session. The old eight-member installer package also did not include the four fixed preplace-i.sh programs and still referenced the incompatible combined-su installer.
goals.required_behavior: Stable program and package identity must not depend on a current session hash, time, nonce or backup inode. Accept those only as strictly validated fixed runtime data, bound to the current action and original lease. An explicit role-aware fixed member contract must replace the old formal deployment path, not leave new code reachable only from tests. Preserve historical v1 material without publishing its incompatible combined-role scripts as the current route.
required_evidence: Two different valid sessions must produce identical stable program bytes but distinct runtime bindings; wrong hashes, malformed backup identities, stale data and wrong action cannot enter the operation. All exact file ownership, xattr, FD and recovery checks remain.

Run the actual content-to-staging-to-fixed-worker-to-maintenance load linkage and independent official recovery. No archive containing real candidate files is published without existing release and final installation approval gates; local pure-memory assembly and hashes are not a successful deployment.

Preserve all first 422 goals and applicability rows unchanged. All these appended requirements remain APPLICABLE/NOT_RUN in the inventory until separately bound full qualification exists; never reuse interrupted RG421 or earlier snapshots for new sources.

Compare the checked paths, label, mode, xattr contract and domains directly with all six generated programs. Prove that an incomplete role route never reaches assembly or publication, including counterfactual test-only qualification.

Bind fresh independent review to exact source/test hashes and preserve all first 431 goals and applicability seed rows. This new requirement remains APPLICABLE/NOT_RUN; local admission tests cannot supply current policy, menu, capture or final installation approval.
goals.title: Match formal qualification to the actual fixed role programs and paths

goals.origin: The saved-candidate recovery loader required exactly the legacy three script hashes and rejected v2 six-program records. Its combined-su recovery renderer still referenced the old backup directory, checked payload health before restoring rc and could adopt a same-content replacement as owned. The process maps loop also could omit inaccessible directories. These are local recovery integration gaps, not evidence of a failed new camera recovery.
goals.required_behavior: Select the exact historical v1 or role-aware v2 contract by explicit format. V2 binds eleven input members plus members.json and all six programs, never a permissive union with install-files.sh or the old combined-su renderer. Restore and verify official rc first using the stable saved backup identity; corrupt or unknown extension payloads and unhealthy capture must not block that proven restoration. After official rc restoration, require complete maintenance-domain process/maps coverage and exact owned placement identities before any optional deletion. Unknown, inaccessible or same-content replacement objects remain retained. A verified already-official rc path may resume recovery without pretending missing cleanup finished.
required_evidence: Exercise real saved archive/hash/manifest loading for both exact formats; reject missing, mixed, extra or changed members/programs and exclude stale preplace-0.sh through preplace-3.sh from recovery-only output. Keep v2 publication refused while its role linkage is incomplete.

Demonstrate official rc restoration independently of broken candidate files, then distinguish official GUI recovery from pending withdrawal. Bind the saved activation backup and four placement receipts as runtime data, not new stable program or archive bytes.

Inject inaccessible process directories, maps read errors and equal-content inode replacements before and after maintenance acknowledgement. Missing full coverage or changed ownership must prevent unlink, preserve files and leave removal unresolved rather than report complete rollback.

Run complete fresh offline and target-qualified recovery gates on exact candidate/package/live identities before installation approval. This append is APPLICABLE/NOT_RUN and neither historical rollback nor a local loader test is present-camera recovery evidence.
goals.title: Load exact v2 recovery content and restore official rc before optional owned removal

X2D-RG-066.scope_reason: No P16_3 rate descriptor, group-0 topology or sensor-transfer recovery is changed. The general rule that sensor/pre-RAW failures must not be described as storage failures remains applicable through RG093, with scoped capture identity under RG118; RG015 separately distinguishes USB and state-transition artifacts. Ordinary stock capture preservation remains required under RG008/RG355.

X2D-RG-111.scope_reason: Every actual native instruction run and its exception path must remain isolated from earlier runs, with no inherited callbacks, counters, register writes or stop reasons. The inspected menu harness creates a fresh Uc for each run; this classification does not assert same-instance reuse or proven hook removal. If engine reuse is introduced, exact hook ownership and finally-path removal must be reviewed and tested before relying on repeated-run evidence.

limitations: Classification is not execution, PASS, package eligibility, installation authority or current hardware evidence.
